plan_review.notes: Adversarial review of ADR 0070 vs shipped code (rubber-duck, gpt-5.4, high effort). 3 alternatives argued against and rejected: (A) unified RewardSource abstraction spanning achievements+boss-chests -- rejected, premature generalization for one additional caller; (B) real ECS-entity chest + bossChestSystem -- rejected, no rendering/AI consumer exists yet per explicit scope exclusion; (C) defer opening state until async UX exists -- rejected, 4-state schema now avoids a future breaking migration. 7 concerns, all resolved: #1 (carryover not wired to a separate real save/load path) rejected with reasoning -- PlayerCarryoverSnapshot IS the only save/load mechanism in the codebase (confirmed via repo-wide grep), so the premise was false. #2 (ADR text stale vs shipped code: wrong base-pool constant name, wrong revealed-bundle-liveness claim, wrong drop/log claim) fixed -- ADR 0070 updated to match code exactly. #3 (no namespace guard against an achievement id colliding with the boss-chest: prefix) fixed -- added BOSS_CHEST_ID_PREFIX shared constant + createAchievementCatalog/parseAchievementCatalog validation guard throwing on collision, createBossChestId updated to consume the same constant, new unit test added. #4 (decapitated.add/goal-flag mutations ran before spawnBossChestForDefeatedBoss, so a resolver throw would permanently latch a boss as defeated with no chest and no retry) fixed -- reordered floor2Scenario.ts so chest spawn now runs first; all affected unit/integration/headless suites re-run and green. #5 (no production caller yet for openBossChest/acknowledgeBossChestReveal) accepted as explicit scope note -- presentation/UX wiring is out of scope per the original ask. #6 (BossChestRecord schema has no entity/location field) accepted as a documented future-extension note, no code change needed at this scope. #7 (getFloor2EquipmentEconomyAccess invalid/disabled collapse) rejected with reasoning -- identical to the existing unlockAchievement precedent (achievementSystem.ts), not a new gap introduced by this slice; fixing would require touching the achievement path too, out of scope.

rounds.notes: sonnet+security(gpt-5.4) clean; codex+gemini independently converged: PLAYER_CARRYOVER_SCHEMA_VERSION never bumped when bossChests was added, so pre-existing v1 snapshots hard-fail restore. Fixed: default bossChests to [] when absent (commit bcc5d9991).
gemini clean; codex found round-1 fix treated explicit null the same as absent, bypassing fail-closed assertArray. Fixed: only default on true key-absence (commit c9944298f).

codex clean; gemini found familyId/createdAtMs never type-checked before use, letting a numeric familyId coerce past the chestId equality check via template-literal interpolation. Fixed: explicit typeof guards + 2 regression tests (commit 5dedc9975).

codex clean (ran full unit/integration/headless boss-chest suites); gemini found (a) absent-key default only applied to bossChests, not the other 3 fields added under the same unbumped schema version, (b) assertArray only checks Array.isArray so a null array element bypasses fail-closed validation. Fixed both + 3 regression tests (commit d06cf274b).

Both models were explicitly prompted to re-check every other array-typed field on PlayerCarryoverSnapshot given 4 prior rounds of findings. All 7 combined findings (achievements.unlockedIds/pendingUnlockIds/claimedIds arrays, ability grant-source array iteration, inventorySlots/disabledEquipmentSlots element guards, playerSkills/persistentStatModifiers assertArray gaps, equippedItemIds string checks) verified via `git diff 9be0328ec..HEAD -- src/game/playerCarryover.ts` to touch ZERO lines modified by this branch -- pre-existing gaps in unrelated code paths (achievements/inventory/skills), not tightly coupled to the boss-chest feature. Filed as GitHub issue #1821 for a dedicated future hardening pass instead of expanding this PR's scope. Retroactive adjudicator (gpt-5.4, general-purpose agent) independently re-ran the same diff check, re-verified rounds 1-4's fixes against current source + the 24 passing tests in tests/unit/player-carryover.test.ts, and confirmed CLEAN: no round-5 finding is tightly coupled to this branch's diff.
